  module full_module (
      input [2:0] r,
      input L,
      input clk,
      output reg [2:0] q);

    always @(posedge clk) begin
      if (L) begin
        q <= r;
      end else begin
        q <= {q[1] ^ q[2], q[0], q[2]};
